column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/event_reset_delay_values.onsa tests=13 evaluated=13 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ a delay reset by an event of a producer below it: the reset is after the save of the stage, as in a named flow
@ a counter reset by an event of its own value is back to 0 after the stage that gave the value
@ vdelay~ reset by an event of a producer below it
@ delay~ back to the write place 0 gives the init for N reads, then the first stored one
@ a reset on the inner delay only, the outer only, or both: only the delay it is written on
@ a reset of sample at the place of the call and a reset of an event after the stage, in either order of the chain
@ an event made in the condition resets before the read, and the producer of the argument that the delay is in ticks after the delay saves
@ a delay of an event reset by an event made in its stage, in another stage, or above it
@ a delay of sample / 4 reset by an event of the same stage written below it, and by an event of the sample stage
@ a source that ticks two inputs of a part: the delay inside is reset by the second input, and the whole part by an event below the call
@ a reset on a flow of the user is the flow with its flows and delays inside, even the event delay that resets it from inside
render event_reset_delay_values.reset_whole sr=0x41000000 in x=[1 6 2 7 3 4 1 1] r=[0 0 0 0 1 0 0 0]
@ the stored value of a delay with an event name and a ^name: the event at its place, the name of the end of the stage, then the reset after the save
@ a run cut after the frame of a reset, with a call of 0 frames, and after reset, gives the same values
